run_evaluate_pretrained_model: run the evaluate script to evaluate a pretrained simplifier model on the TurkCorpus test set
run_prepare_turkcorpus: run the evaluate script which calls prepare_turkcorpus to download and prepare the TurkCorpus dataset
run_prepare_models: run the evaluate script which calls prepare_models to download and prepare pretrained simplifier models
run_get_preprocessors: run the evaluate script which creates preprocessors including LengthRatio, Levenshtein, WordRankRatio, and SentencePiece
run_evaluate_simplifier_on_turkcorpus: run the evaluate script which evaluates a preprocessed simplifier on the TurkCorpus test phase
